text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Distressed ivory ribbed fitted scoop-neck tank, dark blue tiny frayed denim shorts, tall black chunky leather biker boots with wide harness straps.. Add ONLY these accessories: Faded charcoal gray cotton baseball cap with small tonal rectangular front patch; Slim black rectangular sunglasses; Wide black leather belt with large oval brass buckle printed I heart BEER. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 3 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. Faded charcoal gray cotton baseball cap with small tonal rectangular front patch; 2. Slim black rectangular sunglasses; 3. Wide black leather belt with large oval brass buckle printed I heart BEER. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
